title: Kawaihapai Airfield.
bodyText: The official name of the airfield located at Kawaihapai, formerly known as Dillingham Airfield, shall be Kawaihapai Airfield.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Section effective upon the completion of the transfer of the airfield back to the State by the United States Army. L 2001, c 276, §3.

bodyHtml:
[§261-27]  Kawaihapai Airfield.  The official name of the airfield located at Kawaihapai, formerly known as Dillingham Airfield, shall be Kawaihapai Airfield. [L 2001, c 276, §1]

 

Note

 

  Section effective upon the completion of the transfer of the airfield back to the State by the United States Army. L 2001, c 276, §3.
